_comment: Example AI_CLOUDHUB_POLICY_FILE (version 1). Keys named _comment are documentation only and ignored by the Go loader. Rules are ordered; first matching deny or allow wins. Built-in checks (token scopes, agent allowed_drive_ids, agent path prefixes) always run before this file.

rules._comment: Deny agent path/drive access under secret-like prefixes (segment or path match). Complements built-in agent path prefixes.

File-level gate for action job.run: when this rule matches, require_scopes must all be present or the request is denied. Built-in scope checks already require job.run on job routes; this is a redundant/example pattern for file policy (same idea as path secrets above).

Optional example: block agents from provider.write (create/update/delete providers). Leave provider.read allowed so agents can list public provider fields. Remove or comment-out this rule if agents should manage providers. provider.write implies provider.read in the built-in scope map only — file rules still match on the exact action name.
